# `/privileged-recommendations` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /privileged-recommendations/v1

`listPrivilegedEntitlementRecommendationsV1` — List privileged entitlement recommendations — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Returns a list of privileged entitlement recommendation groups. Each group aggregates individual entitlement instances that share the same entitlement name and connector type, along with a recommendation score and instance count.

- Scopes: idn:privilege-rec:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
- Returns 200: array of privilegedrecommendationgroup
